sources.quote: Innate: Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath that enhance each of her abilities based on the number of them collected, stacking up to 120 times.
Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.

"cooldown": {"modifiers": [{"values": [7,7,7,7,7]}], "affectedByCdr": false}, "rechargeRate": [7,7,7,7,7], "castTime": "none"  -- Q is charge-based (recharge, not CDR-scaled cooldown), confirming stocked charges are a real cast resource.

"cooldown": {"modifiers": [{"values": [120,100,80]}], "affectedByCdr": true}, "castTime": "0.25"; Active: "Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones." -- R is the single long-cooldown finisher of the rotation.
"castTime": "0.25"; cooldown values [15,15,15,15,15]; Active: "Syndra propels a wave of force in a cone ... Dark Spheres can be knocked back ... Targets hit are also stunned for 1.25 seconds."

E3 implemented the Transcendent splinter system (splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage), R sphere count (r_spheres). All five slots modeled with sourced numbers.

Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it starts within the window (`_schedule_shared_casts`) ... the shared-timeline version is the superposition with mutual-exclusion, resolved greedily by cast order.
Ability rotation casts (`_schedule_shared_casts`, `_compute_ability_rotation`) | shared-timeline renewal schedule; cast starts within window | EXACT | ... R single-cast

independent_computation.step_1_scenario_decode: The scenario id pins splinters = 120. S1 fixes 120 as Syndra's Splinter-of-Wrath cap (and the Transcendence threshold, +15% AP); S6 confirms the calculator exposes exactly that as the `splinters` option with the 1.15x AP buff. So this scenario runs Syndra at full Transcendent stacks.
independent_computation.step_2_slot_count: 120 splinters is >= the 40-splinter Transcendent threshold on Q (S2), so Dark Sphere is stocked as CHARGES, up to a maximum of 2. S3 corroborates the charge semantics in the cached data itself: Q carries a `rechargeRate` of 7 s and `affectedByCdr: false`, i.e. a recharging charge pool rather than an ordinary cooldown. S6 states the implementation models this as a distinct 'Q2 slot'. Therefore at 120 splinters the rotation has FIVE cast slots (Q, Q2, W, E, R), not the four of a sub-40-splinter Syndra.
independent_computation.step_3_ordering: Under the shared-timeline convention (S7), at t = 0 every slot is off cooldown and both Q charges are stocked, so casts are emitted greedily in slot priority with no gating: Q (castTime 'none' = 0 s), then the second stocked Q charge (still ready, no cooldown to wait on), then W (castTime 'none'), then E (0.25 s), then R (0.25 s). R is emitted last and once only -- S8: 'R single-cast', and S4 gives it a 120/100/80 s cooldown, far beyond any rotation window, while it is also the sphere-consuming finisher that wants Q's spheres already on the ground (S4: 'grabs up to 4 nearby live ones').
independent_computation.step_4_resolved_order: order = [Q, Q2, W, E, R]  ->  order[0]=Q, order[1]=Q2, order[2]=W, order[3]=E, order[4]=R.
independent_computation.step_5_compare: order[3] = E, matching the new value. The old value R is exactly what a FOUR-element rotation [Q, W, E, R] yields at index 3 -- i.e. the stocked second Dark Sphere charge was missing from (or appended after) the rotation, contradicting S2/S3/S6. Inserting the extra front-loaded cast shifts E from index 2 to index 3 and R from index 3 to index 4, which is precisely the observed leaf change.
independent_computation.robustness_note: The conclusion does not depend on the extra front-loaded cast being specifically the Q charge. Syndra's W is also a cast-plus-recast ability whose damage lands on the recast (Syndra.abilities.W[0]: 'Force of Will can be recast while the target is being held' / 'Recast: Syndra throws the grabbed target ... dealing magic damage'; notes: 'The initial cast does not count as an ability activation ... Detonating the ability manually does'). Any single additional legitimate cast slot ahead of E in a Q-W-E-R rotation puts E at index 3 and R at index 4. Every mechanic the cached wiki text documents for Syndra at 120 splinters adds slots BEFORE E, never after it, so R at index 3 is only reachable by omitting a documented slot.

counter_check.could_old_be_right: Only if the rotation legitimately has exactly four casts with R fourth. That requires Syndra to have a single Dark Sphere cast, which S2 contradicts at splinters >= 40 (the scenario pins 120) and S3/S6 contradict structurally (charge pool of 2, modeled Q2 slot). Rejected.
counter_check.could_both_be_wrong: Would require E to sit somewhere other than index 3 in the true order -- e.g. R emitted before E. S8 pins R as a single cast and S4 gives it the longest cooldown and the sphere-consuming finisher role (it grabs live spheres created by Q), so R trailing E is the game-correct and convention-correct placement. No cached source supports R ahead of E. Rejected.

confidence: high on the mechanic (charge/extra front slot at 120 splinters is explicit in the cached wiki text and the audit record); the index-3 identification follows from the documented shared-timeline greedy cast order.
